verdict.rationale: Bento is an observability platform that stores production traces, so controlling how long that data is kept and deleting it is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion APIs, or purge controls. The only time-related item, the CLI's default 30-day window, is a query filter for reading signal firings and says nothing about data retention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
